description: List the Kubernetes (K3s/Talos) clusters in a region with status, version, node pools, API endpoint and installed applications. Paginated: {page, per_page, pages, items}. Kubeconfigs are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/kubernetes/clusters.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

title: List Kubernetes clusters
